bias.en: Bearish · slipped under $609–612, closing on the lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $609–612，收于日内低点附近

read.en: Meta fell 1.3% on Nov 2 to $606.73, trading between $606.41 and $621.69 and closing near the low. It is below the falling 5-day ($615.8), 10-day ($639.3) and 30-day ($702.4) averages, the falling 200-day ($632.0) and the rising 100-day ($632.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($668.0), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Meta 11月2日下跌 1.3%，收于 $606.73，盘中区间 $606.41–621.69，收于日内低点附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$615.8）、10 日（$639.3）和 30 日均线（$702.4）、下行的 200 日均线（$632.0）以及上行的 100 日均线（$632.1）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$668.0），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The close broke the $609.0–612.4 support (Oct 28 and Oct 30 lows, Aug 11 high), now resistance. Resistance is $609.0–612.4, then $615.8–621.7 (5-day, Oct 27 low, Nov 2 high) and $632.0–634.7 (100 and 200-day, Oct 29 high). Support is $605.8–606.4 (Jun 16 high, Nov 2 low), then $600 (Jan 20 low) and $592.6–594.8. A close back above $612.4 would target $620–622; below $600, $593.

r.en: Oct 28 low $609.0 and Oct 30 low $610.1, lost; Aug 11 high $612.4
